_doc: Source of truth: /workspace/CR9_Narration_Script_IKE.md (v2, Daniel's own lines). Drop small MONO takes as <slot>.ogg/.mp3, or up to 3 takes <slot>_1/_2/_3, into ../cr9_sound_pack/{ogg,mp3}/ and rebuild; empty slots play caption-only. Rules: banks pick at random with no repeats (shuffle bag); pass 3 timing (Chico + REX): WAVE lines play the instant a wave appears; COWPOP lines are the KILL taunts: they start at the kill and ride over the melt (pool kept to recorded lines <= 1.2 s where any exist), faded over 120 ms at the eye snap, which never waits for them; TRASH is picked at lock start and waits up to 6.5 s for a gap with no beam lock, then drops; MISSED/TRUCK/LAST_TRUCK lines wait up to 2.5 s for a gap, then drop; SHRED_HIT is the one line allowed mid-play. Song ducks ~6 dB under audible VO. clean: caption/slot used when the clean-language toggle is on (slot gets _Clean suffix if that file exists). ABDUCTED + LAST_TRUCK are live: Daniel approved the abduction system (3 truck lives) in DM at 6:50 PM (America/Phoenix), Oct 18 2026.
